name: Megaphone

contextMeanings.meaning: Dramatizing shouting into the void of socials.

platformNotes.note: Used for announcement-coded and adult-coded big-news tweets. The megaphone is the visible 'big news' default across close-friends replies.
Common in announcement-coded stories and aesthetic-coded launch shares. The megaphone reads as the visible PSA default on story overlays and reply captions.
Default comment-section reaction to adult-coded announcement clips. The megaphone pairs with visual-cue-coded clip reactions; Gen Z reads it as the universal announcement default.
Group-chat reaction to announcement-coded content. The megaphone is the default 'news' tag among close-friends groups.

generationalNotes.note: May use 📣 literally for broadcast or announcement references.

seoTitle: 📣 Megaphone Emoji Meaning - What Does 📣 Really Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the megaphone emoji 📣 really means in texts and social media.

longForm.overview:
The 📣 Megaphone emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a red megaphone with sound waves emanating from the wide end. The visual cue reads instantly as announcement-coded reference, big-news default, or the visible 'hear me out' tag. By 2026 📣 has become the go-to emoji for the announcement-coded reaction, the visible big-news default, and the soft-launch-coded reaction in close-friends and group chats.

In modern chat 📣 does very specific work. People send it as a literal announcement-coded reference, as the visible 'I have news' tag, or as the soft-launch-coded default. The red megaphone with sound waves is the visual cue that the read is news or broadcast. Writers should pick 📣 when the read is announcement or visible 'big news' energy, and avoid it when the read is full-on speaker — 🔊 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
📣 lands on a friend's big-news message, in a work channel where someone is signaling announcement-coded energy, and in a group chat where the sender is signaling 'I have news'. The red megaphone anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 📣 reads as the universal news default and the visible 'announcement' tag. On X the emoji punctuates announcement-coded and big-news tweets. The emoji pairs with 📢 for the layered megaphone-and-loudspeaker stack and with 📣 for the layered megaphone-and-loop-megaphone stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 📣 in any context where the read is supposed to be quiet. The megaphone implies loud announcement, not whisper. Avoid 📣 in casual contexts where the announcement-coded read lands as over-the-top.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 📣 on a news-coded message, mirror with another 📣 or 📢 to send matching energy. The news chain reads as solidarity.

If 📣 lands as the announcement default, reply with another 📣 or 👏. And if you want to send 📣 yourself, pair it with the moment so the announcement-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 📣 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 📣 means announcement-coded reference, big-news energy, or the visible 'hear me out' reaction. The red megaphone is the visual cue that the read is news.

faqs.question: Is 📣 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. 📣 reads as flirty-coded in a dating thread combined with 'soft launch' tag content as going public.

faqs.question: What does 📣 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 📣 carries the same announcement-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 📣 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 📣 is the default sticker on announcement-coded captions and aesthetic-coded launch story overlays.

conversationExamples.interpretation: Friend announcement share. Mirror with another 📣 or 👀 so the news chain reads back.
Work-coded announcement share. Mirror with a clarifying sentence — 📣 can land as off-topic in work channels.
Dating-coded flirty share. Mirror with 📣 or ❤️ so the warm chain reads back.
Family-coded news share. Mirror with 📣 or 🎉 so the family-coded chain reads back.
Public adult-coded broadcast share. Mirror with another 📣 or 📢 so the solidarity chain reads back.
